fusions.name: Mobbing Flock
fusions.desc: Looses 4 strikes spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. Spends 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Scavenger's Due
fusions.desc: Dives into the first enemy it meets, usable only on a target at or below 30% health, dealing 24 damage and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Cornered Retort
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Scrap Sparrow
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded Scrap Sparrow that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage.
